youtube.title: The "I Got Fired" Button: One Press Makes All Repos Public
youtube.description:
Did you know you can turn your entire company codebase public with one physical button press? A developer built a real panic button that triggers instant exit revenge.

If you've ever felt one bad meeting away from quitting, this is yours. Here's how Claude Code turned revenge fantasies into actual hardware.

The button connects to a full automated exit sequence script. Press it once and every private repo goes public instantly. Built entirely with Claude Code in under four hours. Hardware integration, GitHub API automation, zero prior electronics experience.

The old way was slow sabotage over weeks of planning. This button executes the nuclear option in three seconds. Auto-commits, repo visibility flips, notifications to every stakeholder.

Comment BUTTON and I'll send the full automation script and hardware guide.
